package fixturepkg























const (
	// defaultWorkerID is deliberately outside the ordinary fixture range.
	defaultWorkerID       uint16 = 1000
	syntheticRecordPrefix        = "synthetic-record:"

	updateDebounce = 250 * time.Millisecond
	staleInterval  = time.Second
	staleDuration  = 10 * time.Second
)

type thresholdRange struct {
	id      string
	label   string
	target  float32
	minimum float32
	maximum float32
}

var thresholdRanges = []thresholdRange{
	{id: "small", label: "Small", target: 12, minimum: 10, maximum: 16},
	{id: "medium", label: "Medium", target: 24, minimum: 20, maximum: 32},
	{id: "large", label: "Large", target: 48, minimum: 40, maximum: 60},
}

type recordMetadata struct {
	category uint16
	kind     uint16
	variant  uint16
}

// AnnotatedRegistry exercises comment preservation in a multi-file package.
// @restream.store(ExampleRegistry, DeviceWithNoRelay)
type AnnotatedRegistry struct {
	logger     *Logger
	repository *Repository
	index      *Index
	cache      *Cache
	reader     *Reader
	writer     *Writer
	input      chan Item
	output     chan Item
	started    bool
	closed     bool
	revision   uint64
	generation uint64

	metadataMu sync.RWMutex
	metadata   map[uint16]recordMetadata
	aliases    map[string]recordMetadata

	deliveryMu       sync.Mutex
	deliveryGroup    string
	deliverySequence uint8
	deliverySource   *Source

	updateMu sync.Mutex

	providerMu sync.Mutex
	providers  map[string]providerState
	claims     map[string]claimScope

	settingsMu sync.RWMutex
	settings   map[uint]recordSetting
	keyed      map[string]recordSetting
	ranges     map[string]rangeSetting

	records  map[string]*record
	lastSeen map[string]time.Time
	groups   map[string]*group
	summary  summary

	requests       chan struct{}
	pendingUpdates map[string]struct{}
	pendingDeletes map[string]struct{}
	pendingGroups  bool
	pendingSummary bool
	pendingDerived bool
	flushing       bool

	storeData *StoreData[
		RegistryState,
		*RegistryState,
		*RegistryStatePartial,
	]
}

var _ Store = (*AnnotatedRegistry)(nil)
